```{r}
# custom functions for later (flatten the cluster covariance matrices)
coef.multinom_flat <- function(object, ...) {
  B <- NextMethod()
  v <- as.vector(t(B))
  names(v) <- paste(rep(rownames(B), each = ncol(B)),
                    rep(colnames(B), times = nrow(B)), sep = ':')
  v
}

vcov.multinom_flat <- function(object, ...) attr(object, 'V_cl')
```

```{r}
build_variance_components <- function(df, station_vars){#, region_time_vars) {

  # WITHIN RT (region-month-year)
  df <- df %>%
    group_by(Region, region_time) %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        all_of(station_vars),
        list(
          rt_mean = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),   # region-time mean (Xbar_rt)
          within_rt = ~ .x - mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE) # dev per station (d_srt)
        ),
        .names = '{.col}_{.fn}'
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  # BETWEEN REGION (regional mean)
  rt_mean_vars <- paste0(station_vars, '_rt_mean')

  region_means <- df %>%
    distinct(
      Region,
      region_time,
      across(all_of(rt_mean_vars))
    ) %>%
    group_by(Region) %>%
    summarize(
      across(
        all_of(rt_mean_vars),
        ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),  # regional mean (Xbar_r)
        .names = '{.col}_bw_region'
      ),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    rename_with(
      ~ sub('_rt_mean_bw_region$', '_bw_region', .x)
    )

  df <- df %>%
    left_join(region_means, by = 'Region')

  # OVER RT (d_rt = Xbar_rt - Xbar_r)
  for (v in station_vars) {
    df[[paste0(v, '_over_rt')]] <-
      df[[paste0(v, '_rt_mean')]] -
      df[[paste0(v, '_bw_region')]]
  }

  # REGION-TIME VARS (already at rt level; no within-rt, has over_rt/bw_region)
  # region_time_bw <- df %>%
  #   distinct(Region, region_time, across(all_of(region_time_vars))) %>%
  #   group_by(Region) %>%
  #   summarize(
  #     across(
  #       all_of(region_time_vars),
  #       ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
  #       .names = '{.col}_bw_region'
  #     ),
  #     .groups = 'drop'
  #   )
  # 
  # df <- df %>%
  #   left_join(region_time_bw, by = 'Region')
  # 
  # for (v in region_time_vars) {
  #   df[[paste0(v, '_over_rt')]] <-
  #     df[[v]] - df[[paste0(v, '_bw_region')]]
  # }

  df
}
```

```{r}
# calc weighted (due to repeated stations) variance
wvar <- function(x, w) {
  keep <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(w)
  x <- x[keep]
  w <- w[keep]
  mu <- weighted.mean(x, w)
  weighted.mean((x - mu)^2, w)
}

calc_variance_decomp <- function(v, df) {
  within_col <- paste0(v, '_within_rt')
  over_col <- paste0(v, '_over_rt')
  bw_col <- paste0(v, '_bw_region')
  
  has_within <- within_col %in% names(df)
  required_cols <- c(v, over_col, bw_col, if (has_within) within_col)
  
  tmp <- df %>%
    filter(if_all(all_of(required_cols), ~ !is.na(.))) %>%
    group_by(Region, region_time) %>%
    mutate(wt = 1 / n()) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  total_var <- wvar(tmp[[v]], tmp$wt)
  var_over <- wvar(tmp[[over_col]], tmp$wt)
  var_between <- wvar(tmp[[bw_col]], tmp$wt)
  var_within <- if (has_within) wvar(tmp[[within_col]], tmp$wt) else 0
  
  data.frame(
    variable = v,
    perc_within_rt = if (has_within) (var_within / total_var) * 100 else NA,
    perc_over_rt = (var_over / total_var) * 100,
    perc_bw_region = (var_between / total_var) * 100,
    perc_sum = ((var_within + var_over + var_between) / total_var) * 100
  ) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2)))
}

```

## All Flows

```{r}
m_bab_af <- glm(
  BAB ~
    Temperature_over_rt +
    
    log_Turbidity_lag_within_rt + log_Turbidity_lag_over_rt +
    
    log_Conductivity_over_rt + Region +
    
    log_SAC + log_SJR + log_EXPORTS +
    
    log_SAC_lag3 + log_SJR_lag3 + log_EXPORTS_lag3 +
    
    log_DIN_lag_within_rt + log_DIN_lag_over_rt +
    
    frac_NH4_lag_within_rt + frac_NH4_lag_over_rt +
    
    # log_DissAmmonia_lag_within_rt + log_DissAmmonia_lag_over_rt +
    
    # log_DissNitrateNitrite_lag_within_rt + log_DissNitrateNitrite_lag_over_rt +
    
    log_DissSilica_lag_within_rt + log_DissSilica_lag_over_rt +
    
    log_DissOrthophos_lag_within_rt + log_DissOrthophos_lag_over_rt,
  
  data = df_bab,
  family = binomial
)

V_rt_date <- vcovCL(
  m_bab_af,
  cluster = ~ region_time + Date,
  cadjust = TRUE
)

lmtest::coeftest(
  m_bab_af,
  vcov. = V_rt_date
)
```

```{r}
  ~ Temperature_over_rt +
    log_Turbidity_lag_within_rt + log_Turbidity_lag_over_rt +
    log_Conductivity_over_rt + Region +
    log_SAC + log_SJR + log_EXPORTS +
    log_SAC_lag3 + log_SJR_lag3 + log_EXPORTS_lag3 +
    log_DIN_over_rt +
    log_DissSilica +
    log_DissOrthophos_within_rt +
    log_DIN_lag3_over_rt +
    log_DissSilica_lag3 +
    log_DissOrthophos_lag3_within_rt,
  data = subset(df_nosb, Temperature >= 0.55)
)

X <- X[, -1, drop = FALSE]

vif <- sapply(seq_len(ncol(X)), function(j) {
  1 / (1 - summary(lm(X[, j] ~ X[, -j]))$r.squared)
})

names(vif) <- colnames(X)
sort(vif, decreasing = TRUE)
```

```{r}
df_subset <- df_hbab %>% filter(Temperature >= 0.55)

library(brms)
fit_bayes_re <- brm(
  HAB ~ doy_z +
    Temperature_over_rt +
    log_Turbidity_lag_within_rt +
    Region +
    log_SAC + log_SJR +
    log_SAC_lag + log_SJR_lag +
    log_SAC_lag3 + log_SJR_lag3 +
    log_DIN_over_rt +
    log_DissSilica_over_rt +
    log_DissOrthophos_within_rt +
    log_DIN_lag_over_rt +
    log_DIN_lag3_over_rt +
    log_DissOrthophos_lag_within_rt +
    log_DissSilica_lag_over_rt +
    log_DissSilica_lag3_over_rt +
    log_DissOrthophos_lag3_within_rt +
    (1 | region_time) +
    (1 | Date),
  
  data = df_subset,
  family = bernoulli("logit"),
  
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
    prior(normal(0, 2.5), class = "Intercept"),
    prior(exponential(1), class = "sd")
  ),
  
  chains = 2,
  iter = 1000,
  warmup = 500,
  cores = 2,
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  seed = 123
)

summary(fit_bayes_re)
```

# Extra

```{r}
ldcurve <- function(model, var) {

  dat <- model.frame(model)
  response <- names(dat)[1]

  newdat <- dat[1, , drop = FALSE]

  for (x in names(dat)) {
    if (x != response && x != var && is.numeric(dat[[x]])) {
      newdat[[x]] <- mean(dat[[x]], na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  }

  if ('Region' %in% names(dat)) {
    newdat$Region <- factor('Central', levels = levels(dat$Region))
  }

  # vary predictor across its observed range
  x <- seq(
    min(dat[[var]], na.rm = TRUE),
    max(dat[[var]], na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = 1000
  )

  newdat <- newdat[rep(1, 1000), , drop = FALSE]
  newdat[[var]] <- x

  # predictions and 95% CI
  pred <- predict(model, newdata = newdat, type = 'link', se.fit = TRUE)

  prob <- plogis(pred$fit)
  lo <- plogis(pred$fit - 1.96 * pred$se.fit)
  hi <- plogis(pred$fit + 1.96 * pred$se.fit)

  # predictor value corresponding to 5% probability
  threshold <- NA_real_

  if (0.05 >= min(prob) && 0.05 <= max(prob)) {
    o <- order(prob)
    threshold <- approx(
      x = prob[o],
      y = x[o],
      xout = 0.05
    )$y
  }

  # plot
  plot(
    x, prob,
    type = 'n',
    ylim = c(0, 1),
    xlab = var,
    ylab = 'Cond. Probability of HAB'
  )

  polygon(
    c(x, rev(x)),
    c(hi, rev(lo)),
    col = 'grey80',
    border = NA
  )

  lines(x, prob, lwd = 2)
  lines(x, hi, lty = 'dashed')
  lines(x, lo, lty = 'dashed')

  abline(h = 0.05, lty = 'dashed')

  if (!is.na(threshold)) {
    abline(v = threshold, lty = 'dashed')
  }

  return(threshold)
}
```

```{r}
ldcurve(m_hbab_af_s, 'log_SAC')
```
```{r}
ldcurve(m_hbab_af_s, 'log_SAC_lag3')
```
